description: This file declares GPU kernel functions for efficient attention backpropagation using the CUTLASS library across multiple CUDA architectures (Sm50, Sm70, Sm80). It includes kernel launch bounds, template dispatch functions, and references external kernel implementations for different data types (half, bfloat16, float) and configurations.
